what: AKS + agent-sandbox v0.5.2 on a Kata node pool: build, apply the Sandbox, answer, delete the pod, suspend and resume by patching operatingMode
operator_shell: Windows + Git Bash (az 2.88.0, azd 1.34.1, kubectl, containerapp ext 1.3.0b5, azure-containerapps-sandbox 0.1.0b4)
module: module-03 (the workshop calls it Solution B)
kata_isolation_method: uname -r inside the Sandbox pod, and inside a pod without runtimeClassName that the scheduler placed on the Ubuntu system pool (workshop module-03, 'Verify Pod Sandboxing Kernel Isolation')
inputs: not retained: the run summary records timings and outcomes, not the request text
notes: Storage account had public network access Disabled (a subscription policy), so the Blob private endpoint step was required
Git Bash converts /subscriptions/... arguments to Windows paths; MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 fixed the private-link deployment
No idle timeout or wake-on-request in the Sandbox CRD; suspend/resume was patched manually as the README describes
The public LoadBalancer was restricted with loadBalancerSourceRanges to one operator address
